svg.aria-label: Featured projects. Tobi — A desktop companion for monitoring AI coding agents and responding to requests. TrayMixer — A system tray mixer for switching audio devices and adjusting app volume. Lumen — A GNOME Shell extension for per-display brightness control. Okto — A planner that brings tasks, calendars and focus sessions together.
